\vspace{2pt}
\parbox{\textwidth}{\footnotesize W0: scores frozen on 31 March 2026, labels counted from April to June 2026. W1: scores frozen on 30 June 2026, labels counted from July to September 2026. In the revised analysis every score is computed from the twelve months before its freeze, in the registered analysis from every extracted event since 1 October 2023. Spenders are the contracts that hold a positive latest allowance at the freeze; traders are the GMX~V2 accounts that hold contract code, are nodes of the freeze-date graph and close at least three positions in the label window. In the revised analysis 1{,}732 W0 spenders gained a new approval pair and 1{,}422 a new transfer sender, and 1{,}495 and 1{,}371 W1 spenders did; in the registered analysis 3{,}403, 3{,}042, 2{,}850 and 2{,}812. Of the 70 W1 traders, 9 had at least one liquidation. The degree, EndorseRank and AWP rows are reference scores; the companion study \cite{kwon2026companion} reports their comparisons in full. Intervals: 400 paired resamples over the contracts of the cohort, seed 42.}
